propositions: Whitespace-only boundary/trailing edits to no_file_impact_reason incorrectly invalidate signed attestations by changing the material fingerprint, violating the whitespace-normalization invariant.
The raw no_file_impact_reason is inserted byte-for-byte into material_basis when file_impact_scope is 'none' and hashed without normalization, while the description field is canonicalized.

Adding a normalize_reason parameter to material_basis, material_fingerprint, and current_material_fingerprint_impl enables consistent insignificant-whitespace canonicalization for the reason field matching the description treatment.

Legacy attestations from three historical generations (pre-330c raw, post-330c/pre-2be7 checkbox-normalized, post-2be7/pre-fix canonical-description/raw-reason) must remain valid by explicitly disabling reason normalization in _legacy_material_ok.
Interior whitespace changes and word changes to no_file_impact_reason remain material and produce distinct fingerprints, preserving security boundaries.
